newsitem.title: GERMANY: Six injured in German copper plant accident.
newsitem.headline: Six injured in German copper plant accident.

text.p: An accident at German copper smelter Norddeutsche Affinerie (NA) AG injued six workers, but did not affect production, the company said on Friday.
The men were injured by a burst of flame after oxygen leaked from a flask being used in repair work at the continous casting shop around six am in the morning.
Of the six, four had already been released from hospital and the other two were due to be released next week, a spokeswoman said.
Police were investigating the cause of the accident but production continued unabated.
The metals refiner aimed to produce 350,000 tonnes of cathodes in 1995/96.
